sections.h2: Painting around real life in Gainesville
body: CertaPro Painters of Gainesville is one of the painting and property-service companies Gainesville homeowners may be comparing. If your project is an interior repaint, the paint itself is only part of the decision. You will be cooking, working from home, getting kids to school, and maybe keeping pets calm while a crew moves through the house. How a contractor plans for that is worth asking about directly.

This page does not describe how any other company handles occupied homes. It lists the questions we would want answered before letting any crew inside, and it explains what Precision Paint Experts does so you have a concrete comparison point.
Before you sign with anyone, get clear answers to these:
bullets: Do we need to leave the house, and for how long?
Who moves the furniture, and how is it protected?
Will you work one room at a time or open up the whole floor?
What products will be used, and are low-VOC options available?
What time does the crew arrive and leave each day?

sections.h2: How we handle an occupied home
body: You do not need to leave the house. Our crews move and protect furniture and work room by room, so most of your home stays usable while one space is being painted. That approach also keeps the disruption predictable: you know which room is off limits today and which one opens back up tomorrow.

We offer low-VOC and eco-conscious material options, which many families with young children, pets, or sensitivities prefer for bedrooms and living areas. Ask for them during the walkthrough and they will be named on the estimate. Our Gainesville interior painting page has more on the rooms we paint most often.

A single interior room usually takes one day. A whole-home interior takes anywhere from three days to two weeks, depending on size, repairs, ceilings, trim, and the number of colors. Interiors can be done in any season, which makes them easier to fit around your calendar than an exterior, whether that means before guests arrive or after a semester ends.

If ceilings or walls need work first, that time should be on the schedule too. Our drywall repair and ceiling and popcorn removal services are written into the same estimate when they are part of the job, so nothing surprises you halfway through.

Our walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and a crew lead, not a salesperson, does the measuring. The itemized estimate usually arrives within one business day and lists rooms included and excluded, prep, products, coats, and the schedule. Compare it against any other Gainesville bid with the logistics questions above in hand, and note how each one describes protection for floors, furniture, and fixtures. If you are still deciding on colors, our post on Florida interior paint colors is a good place to start.

faqs.q: Can I stay home and work while you paint?
faqs.a: Yes. Crews move and protect furniture and work room by room, so most of the house stays usable each day.

faqs.q: Do you offer low-VOC paint for bedrooms?
faqs.a: Yes. Low-VOC and eco-conscious options are available, and the chosen product is named on your estimate.

faqs.q: Are you part of CertaPro Painters of Gainesville?
faqs.a: No. Precision Paint Experts is a separate, locally owned company based in Newberry, FL.
